In the past, the same EoS for WD matter was used in Ref. [45] to study the radial stability of DWDs, although in the one-fluid limit with a free DM fluid by fixing the central DM Fermi momentum. Besides, Ref. [57] explored the tidal deformability of two-fluid DWD configurations at fixed q = MDM/MOM, which is related to our FDM = q/(1 + q). Unlike their approach, we map the full coupled radial spectrum over a two-dimensional DWD central-pressure domain, rather than selecting fixed-q sequences. We use mf = 5 GeV and y = 0.1, for which the original scan produces the largest sampled DWD population.
